read: The crowd wants to feel cool and connected; I'll build an undeniable vibe with warm, foundational grooves that makes them forget about leaving.

tracks.title: Everybody Loves The Sunshine
tracks.why: The ultimate sunset track. It's a warm, soulful welcome for the entire rooftop.
tracks.transition: Let the synth fade almost to silence, then introduce the next iconic bassline.

tracks.title: Footsteps in the Dark, Pts. 1 & 2
tracks.why: Introduce a recognizable, low-slung funk groove. It's sexy, cool, and builds momentum subtly.
tracks.transition: Ride out the guitar solo, blending its soulful grit into the next track’s beat.

tracks.title: All This Love That I'm Givin'
tracks.why: A noticeable lift. A powerful female vocal over a chunky, undeniable soulful funk groove.
tracks.transition: Use the vocal breaks to loop and filter into the next track's percussive chaos.

tracks.title: Go Bang! #5 (Francois K Mix)
tracks.why: The pivot. A weird, percussive disco classic that signals the night is getting interesting.
tracks.transition: Let the wild percussive loops run, slowly blending in iconic 909 hi-hats.

tracks.title: Can You Feel It
tracks.why: After the chaos, a moment of pure house emotion. Unifying, deep, timelessly beautiful.
tracks.transition: Mix out on the synth pads, letting the next track’s acapella take over.

tracks.title: Let No Man Put Asunder (A Shep Pettibone Mix)
tracks.why: The invitation. An iconic acapella drops into a joyful, irresistible garage house classic.
tracks.transition: This is the first real dance track; let it play and mix decisively.
